Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU`
Thread session: `session_01L9qibyHmxFV4bTFZ5BKnUz`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/project-thread-j4n4b0`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-38150`
Domain: `runtime`
Area: `o3-studio` (area:ux p2, a seat card thread; topic #37424 phase 4, card 4-2). Seat 3 builds it: the card's "PR-A goes to the spec lane" wording is a script leftover (execution-duties.md:104), and no card moves.
Seat: `repo:objectstack#3`
Seat rulings on the pre-claim report (`/mnt/project-files/card-38150/pre-claim-report-581ae76a.md`, main 581ae76a):
- PR-A splits into PR-A1 (server, now) and PR-A2 (console, after #38149 merges, reusing its package picker). Three PRs carry this one card. The card's rule that PR-A ships in the same release as PR-B stands. PR-B waits on the maintainer's Q-f answer.
- The move reuses the save door's own checks the way `publishPackageDrafts` does (ADR-0067 D2). Each item goes through the save door into the target package, then the loose row is deleted, all in one `engine.transaction()` with the undo path where the engine cannot roll back. The set rule runs first. A dry run takes the same path and always rolls back. The 2250-line save method is not split.
- The ADR-0150 D3 (a) reader is `collectReferenceHits` (`protocol-reference-hits.ts`) walked in reverse, plus `reference-sites.ts`. Names resolve through `resolvePackageScopedName` over `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`.
- The package commit uses `operation: 'apply'`, with the message naming the move. No new operation value.
- #37468's `Blocked-by:` already names this card (body patched, state 7234131457).
File surface (PR-A1):
- `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/move-in` with body `{ items: [{ type, name, member? }], dryRun?: boolean }`. It keeps the `adopt-orphans` door's gates (`requireManageMetadata`, the wall refusal, the knowledge-source gate, no query params, `requireWritablePackage`) and adds the installed-target check through `uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal` (`422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`).
- A protocol method beside `protocol-package-commits.ts` (or its own facet file), the mount, a route-ledger row, request and answer schemas in `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`, SDK `packages.moveIn`, and the five regenerated spec baselines.
- Tests: #37468's three regressions (uninstalled target, namespace prefix, readable without a restart); the set test (a flow alone is refused naming its dataset, and both together move); one test per save-door check (child K, owner, permission-set owner, `__c`); `.custom` pair items and published overlays are refused as not loose; the `_env` address measured on the new door. Loose rows are inserted through the system context, as `flow-shipped-name-layered-read.dogfood.test.ts:204` does.
- One `.changeset/*.md` (patch).
- Run `overlap-check.mjs` before the first push. #37401 and #37958 touch PR-A2's files only.
Stop on breach and explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:thread`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates.mjs --tier: "no path-derived mandate" (package-lifecycle.zod.ts reads Clause ② SUSPECT)`, `effort: high`, reason: the thread session serves effort high
Writes: the PR only through the relay `pr_create`; comments, labels and bodies only through the relay write tools; report both numbers.
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: an admin moves loose metadata into an installed writable package through one door that runs the save door's own checks. The move is all-or-nothing, writes history, and is readable at once without a restart. A dry run shows the same answer without writing. PR-A1 owes a contract-review L2 (packages/spec/src/api).
Thread-read: none
Premise: holds, spot-checked on origin/main 581ae76a; the two "not verified" items are measured in the report
Serial constraints cleared: `#38149 (zone, claim 7234141707) touches PR-A2's files only; PR-A1 does not overlap it`

repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Claim amendment (protocol declaration and changeset grade), for claim 7234216673, PR-A1 #38185. `Metadata-protocol: none` becomes `Metadata-protocol: added`: the five MoveIntoPackage* request/response schemas enter the `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` shard, and `check-changeset-no-major` refuses `none` when an authorable-surface shard moves. No metadata key an author writes is added. The changeset grades `@objectstack/spec` `minor` (the others stay `patch`). Precedent: `.changeset/pre/35928-record-update-starts-read.md` (new `@objectstack/spec/api` route schemas, `added`, spec minor). `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is unchanged; the contract-review L2 owed before the queue reads this line.
